decisions.description: The source omits absolute section/material properties. This authored appendix freezes Q355 steel E=206000 MPa, nu=0.3, G=E/[2(1+nu)] MPa, rho=7850 kg/m3, and B1 solid rectangle 0.3 m by 0.6 m with explicit A/Iy/Iz/J. They are inputs, not engine defaults.

Horizontal members run in +X; local y is global +Y. Uz is global +Z displacement; Rz is global +Z support reaction. Requested fixed-end My is the global +Y support reaction moment, signed by the right-hand rule.
All point-load and displacement observation locations use connected beam nodes. Extra internal stations have no added planar support or mass.
Only source/structural authoring checks have run. Independent numerical reference, native engine execution, adapter acceptance and blind input review remain pending.
